intended_object: The analytic affine toric chart U_σ(ℂ) of a cone σ of a fan: the complex points Hom_{ℂ-alg}(ℂ[S_σ], ℂ) ≅ Hom_monoid(S_σ, ℂ) of the affine toric variety, where S_σ = σ^∨ ∩ M. It carries the classical topology induced by evaluating at a finite generating set of S_σ. Inferred from the docstring, the module docs and the references (Fulton §1.3–1.4, CLS §3.1).
explanation: The carrier is `MonoidAlgebra ℂ (Multiplicative S_σ) →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ` with S_σ = `dualSemigroup`, the integral characters that are nonnegative on σ, i.e. σ^∨ ∩ M. These are exactly the ℂ-points of Spec ℂ[S_σ]. The topology is induced by the monomial embedding into ℂ^r for a finite generating family of S_σ. Such a family exists because the dual semigroup of a toric cone is finitely generated (Gordan). The family is chosen classically, but `affinePointTopology_eq` / `analyticAffineChart_str_eq` show the topology does not depend on the choice, so this is the standard classical topology on U_σ(ℂ). The general construction `AffineSemigroupComplexPoint` with `affinePointTopology` is already stated for any finitely generated commutative monoid; this definition only specialises it to the chart of a cone in a fan, which is its intended content. Mathlib has no analytification of affine toric varieties, so there is no counterpart and the definition is not too narrow.
